name: Woodland
about:
Woodland was founded in 1996 by Lynn and Pat Harker in Idaho Falls, Idaho. Pat Harker, drawing on experience from her design firm Harker Design, envisioned a resource that would serve interior designers with high-quality products, service excellence, delivery in under 12 weeks, and fair pricing. The company began with that four-part ideal and has remained privately held by its founders.

Today Woodland produces cabinetry, lighting, and upholstery as a whole-home solution for designers. The operation emphasizes custom designs and custom finishes, relying on craft and artistry rather than full automation. The facility earned the Shingo Prize in 2000 for excellence in lean manufacturing, reflecting a commitment to continuous improvement on the shop floor.

The primary customers are interior design professionals and design firms seeking tailored residential furnishings. Designers specify Woodland pieces for custom residential projects, relying on the company’s ability to translate design intent into finished cabinetry, lighting fixtures, and upholstered goods.

Woodland differentiates itself through its dedication to handcrafted custom work, a stated delivery target of under 12 weeks, and a pricing philosophy described as fair. The Shingo Prize recognition underscores a lean manufacturing culture that the company says supports both quality and responsiveness.
